proves.claim: The doctrine tab, first and repeat click, paints under TAB_SPEED_GOAL_MS or its audited row in tab-speed-rows.mjs.

cli.journeys-init-perf-tab-speed-doctrin.why: Without it, a doctrine tab that paints over its audited row on the large board would pass unnoticed, and the doctrine pair file would still run over its file budget.
